person.name: Patrick Vieira
person.headline: Lead Platform Engineer
person.tagline: I build the platforms, infrastructure and identity systems that let a small team ship like a large one — with AI agents held to the same standard as people.

about: I lead platform engineering at Altimist, a London fintech, reporting to the CEO. I own the architecture, infrastructure, identity and security, and I set the engineering standards the company builds to.

I built and run the company's internal developer platform for AI-assisted delivery, and I hold agent-written code to the same standard as anyone's: a written spec before code, tests first, a hook that stops an agent finishing until typecheck, lint and tests pass, and adversarial review by a model from a second vendor.

Before software I took a BEng in Electrical and Electronic Engineering and a PGCE at UCL, then taught secondary maths. Teaching shaped how I build tooling: it only counts if people pick it up and use it well.

work.title: Internal developer platform for AI-assisted delivery
work.summary: The Claude Code platform the company builds with: a plugin of 21 skills and 3 hook events for spec-first authoring, test-driven implementation and cross-vendor adversarial review, plus a versioned engineering-standards baseline that fans out automatically to about 26 repositories.

work.title: Software Factory
work.summary: An agent execution and evaluation platform. Coding agents take specified work, build in sandboxed containers with per-run credentials, pass rubric-graded review gates and merge on automated criteria. The platform choice was settled by a measured spike: 3.3 s cold start, 32 ms warm.

work.title: Passkey and verifiable-credential identity
work.summary: altimist-id, built from scratch: did:web identity with WebAuthn passkeys and W3C Verifiable Credentials, the sign-in for the company's internal applications, with federation to self-hosted DIDs — including this domain.

work.title: Infrastructure as code
work.summary: Cloud and SaaS infrastructure run through Terraform Cloud with GitOps — plan on pull request, apply on merge, daily drift detection — across GitHub, Cloudflare, Kafka, Databricks and observability. AWS and Microsoft 365 as code; joiners and leavers automated.

work.title: On-premises speech intelligence
work.summary: A meeting-transcription pipeline on an NVIDIA DGX Spark — NeMo ASR, diarisation and voiceprint speaker naming — for audio that cannot leave the building.

side_projects.title: Kaizen Kingdom
side_projects.summary: An adaptive maths learning platform, built from what I saw in the classroom: the gap between what teachers need and what edtech actually provides.

side_projects.title: Marine-weather agent
side_projects.summary: An agent that emails forecasts to a sailing yacht at sea.
